To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a new approach to reinforcement learning that is capable of learning complex policies for tasks specified by logical formulas.
we propose an approach to learn control policies from high-level logical specifications by interleaving reinforcement learning and planning.

(1) we propose DIRL, a compositional reinforcement learning approach for learning policies from logical specifications that interleaves high level planning and learning; (2) we evaluate DIRL on a set of benchmarks with continuous state spaces and actions spaces and demonstrate that DIRL outperforms state of the art baselines; and (3) the key contributions of this work are a novel compositional approach to reinforcement learning and a set of experiments that demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach on a set benchmarks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of learning to control complex dynamical systems from logical specifications.
the development and analysis of novel reinforcement learning algorithms for continuous control.
the development of compositional approaches that combine planning and learning to solve challenging control problems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is a significant improvement over the state-of-the-art.
the proposed compositional learning approach is able to learn complex tasks given by specifications that are beyond the reach of state-of-the-art reinforcement learning methods.

this work presents a novel approach for compositional reinforcement learning from logical specifications, and that the proposed method outperforms state of the art approaches on a set of complex control benchmarks with continuous states and actions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we develop a new approach to learn policies for complex tasks that require both high-level planning and fine-grained control.

we have proposed a novel compositional reinforcement learning approach, which is able to learn policies from logical specifications, and outperforms state of the art methods on a set of continuous control benchmarks.
we propose a new reinforcement learning approach that can learn complex control policies by combining high-level planning and learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compositional reinforcement learning can be a promising direction for learning control policies for tasks that require high level planning.
by leveraging compositional planning, one can significantly improve the sample efficiency of learning control policies.
by interleaving high-level planning and learning, it is possible to learn policies for complex tasks that are intractable for standard approaches.
